claim.statement: Parent_3 used a piecewise quadratic spline but had wrong coefficients for x0>=20. This repairs the approach by fitting four quadratic segments directly to the fresh training data in the range [26,43]. Coefficients are chosen to minimize residuals on each segment. This avoids the cubic blowup seen in parent_5 and parent_9.
